type Number interface{~int|~int64}
type Node[T any] struct{ Next *Node[T]; Value T }
func(n *Node[T]) Get()T{return n.Value}
func(n Node[T]) Map[U any](f func(T)U)Node[U]{return Node[U]{Value:f(n.Value)}}
type Alias[T any] = Node[T]
type Scalar int
func(Scalar) Value()int{return 1}
type Recursive interface { Again() Recursive }
type Layout struct { Small byte; Data [3]int64; private string `json:"private"`; Pointer unsafe.Pointer; Chan chan<- int; Map map[string]*Node[int] }

type B[_ any] interface{ f() A[B[any]] }

var Pointer unsafe.Pointer
